properties.name: WHAT WORKED (field log 2026-10-01 on 0.76.0, re-measured 2026-10-05 on main): compare_designs with base_path set to the committed export shows exactly what the live store holds that the export does not (field: 20 added and 20 changed, then 49, which stopped an export that would have swept in another session's work). An import then re-export compares identical. Do not regress it
properties.statement:
Field log [works] (art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05, entries of 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-02): "compare_designs with base_path showed exactly how the live hub store diverged from its export (20 added / 20 changed — another session's uncommitted work)" and "compare_designs with base_path = the committed export showed exactly which unexported nodes the live store held (49), which is what stopped an export that would have bundled someone's in-progress work." 2026-10-02: "compare_designs live vs export read identical: true straight after the export."

RE-MEASURED on main, through --call: a store with 2 nodes and 1 edge was exported, one requirement was added and not exported, and compare_designs with base_path at that export gave `design_added: 1, identical: false, nodes_unchanged: 2, edges_unchanged: 1`. An import of the export into a fresh store, compared against the same file, gave `identical: true`.

It is the reporter's instrument against fact:recurrence-one-store-holds-every-sessions-writes-so-an-export-sweeps-in-anothers-work-2026-10-05. It tells a person what is unexported, though not whose.
